Report the actual moving death-backpack position through the Core lifecycle API. Successful owner inventory pickup completes the bound Nexus death node exactly once; full inventories and foreign pickup do not count as recovery. Works with Nexus 0.3.19 close recovery and Phasing; the effect itself is owned by Nexus. Requires TotemCore 0.7.19 or newer. Remnant continues to work without Nexus.
